Container.Name: Cruncharr
Container.Overview: Cruncharr is a self-hosted Crunchyroll downloader with an *arr-style web UI. Search and queue series, pick dub/sub languages, browse a release calendar, and track download history. Includes Sonarr integration (matches your library and shows what you already have) and a multi-profile language sync that sets your defaults from the Crunchyroll profile you log in with. Multi-architecture image (amd64 and arm64). Set PUID/PGID to match the owner of your appdata and downloads shares so the container can write. Widevine DRM device files are required in /widevine to download DRM-protected content.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: crunchyroll anime downloader sonarr seerr arr
Container.Requires: Internet access and a Crunchyroll account. Widevine device files (in /widevine) are required for DRM-protected downloads.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Cruncharr web UI.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores cruncharr.yaml, history, queue, auth token and logs.

Config.Name: Widevine
Config.Description: Place device_client_id_blob.bin and device_private_key.pem here. Required for DRM-protected content.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. Match the owner of your config and downloads shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as.

Config.Name: API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: require this key to access the API/UI. Leave blank to disable the gate.

Config.Name: Crunchyroll Email (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: pre-fill the Crunchyroll login email. Can also be set in the web UI.

Config.Name: Crunchyroll Password (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: pre-fill the Crunchyroll password. Can also be set in the web UI.
